item: the re-index resume drain and the article-index build stand aside while the storage guard is engaged
summary: The guard paused collection, the housekeeping lane and the heavy reads while a reader pinned the write-ahead log, but the re-index resume drain and the article-index build never asked, so the log reached 80 and 220 GB in the field. StorageGuard.wait_if_engaged gained should_stop and on_wait; the drain waits before each batch and from the second poll of each call (a commit has ended the transaction by then), the index build waits before each statement with the attempt record given back for the length of the wait. Both follow the log and the drive latch, say why on the job row (keyed x12), resume by themselves and still end on a stop. 18 mutants of the new checks are killed by the new tests.
